ns2:section.sectionText: Students will utilize a combination of LON-CAPA lessons, Zoom or Blackboard Collaborate-based discussion sections and office hours, and required e-book access. Students are required to attend one of the two Zoom or Blackboard Collaborate sessions, either from 12:30-2:30 pm or from 3:00 -5:00 pm, on Fridays. This section may have one or more proctored online exams which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU, approved proctoring centers, and approved testing facilities that carry no fees.
